name: FLA_ACCOUNTING_HEADERS_ALL
description: FLA_ACCOUNTING_HEADERS_ALL contains accounting transactions generated within Lease Accounting for booking, revision, termination, accurals, reclassification, expiry, right of use adjustment and payment approval.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Accounting transaction identifier. It is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the lease as captured in FLA_LEASE_DETAILS.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail identifier. It is referenced from FLA_LEASE_DETAILS table.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Accounting transaction reference number.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Accounting transaction type like BOOKING, ACCRUAL, PAYMENT, REVISION, TERMINATION and so forth.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Source reference date. This is Payment items due date or Schedule header transaction date or Accrual schedule date.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Accounting transaction status code like PENDING, PROCESSED, ERRORED and so forth.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the transaction header.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the categorization of accounting events that is unique within an application and event class. This is referenced from XLA_EVENTS table.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier as defined in general ledger.

columns.name: REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Regime code. This drives the accounting model and reporting for the lease.

columns.name: PROCESSING_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: Transaction processing sequence number for the accounting transactions.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period based on Schedule date or payment item due date.

columns.name: LINKED_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Linked transaction ID column. This will be used to maintain link between two transactions.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date which will be sent to Subledger Accounting.

columns.name: REVERSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this transaction is reversed.

columns.name: PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Source Transaction Identifier in case this transaction is for a reversal.

columns.name: SWEEP_PROCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the transaction is marked for accounting period sweep.

columns.name: SOURCE_REFERENCE_ID1
columns.description: Source reference ID identifier 1. For future use.

columns.name: SOURCE_REFERENCE_ID2
columns.description: Source reference ID identifier 2. For future use.

columns.name: SOURCE_REFERENCE_ID3
columns.description: Source reference ID identifier 3. For future use.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BALANCE_SYNC_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the job that created or last updated the row. This is used for request created for the purpose of lease balances.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_IN_GL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the accounting was done into general ledger.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_TIEBACK_DATE
columns.description: Date the accounted amounts are derived and tied back.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
